name: Direct DXF Preflight, Single-Part RFQ Intake Screening & Verified Reporting
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.1 adds Direct DXF Preflight inside Waterjet 2D Studio, Single-Part RFQ Intake Screening from the first screen, and a unified p3dw.finding/1 contract with HTML screening reports — while keeping CAD & DXF geometry 100% offline on your PC.

highlights.title: Single-Part RFQ Intake Screening
highlights.text: Compute Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) stock envelopes alongside AABB, verify watertight volume and material mass (strictly withheld rather than zero when topology or units are unverified), summarize STEP AP242 PMI, track Customer PDF drawings separately, and copy ready-to-send clarification questions for free.

highlights.title: Direct DXF Preflight in Waterjet 2D Studio
highlights.text: Inspect uploaded R12–R2018 ASCII DXFs without blind assumptions: catch missing or conflicting $INSUNITS/$MEASUREMENT headers, preview side-by-side mm vs. inch bounds, block unsupported splines/inserts/3D polylines, visualize Origin (0,0) and 1:1 extent boxes, and approve before/after Overkill cleanup before exporting a clean copy.

highlights.title: Shared p3dw.finding/1 Contract & HTML Review Packets
highlights.text: Every RFQ and DXF preflight finding records explicit status, method, unit basis, and parser coverage inside self-contained Pro HTML Review & Screening Reports.

highlights.title: Waterjet PDF → DXF/DWG, Native SolidWorks/NX & 15-Day Pro Trial
highlights.text: Full 15-day no-card Pro trial unlocking PDF/DXF waterjet exports, bundled local SolidWorks (.SLDPRT/.SLDASM) & Siemens NX (.prt) setup, 4-GiB OCCT kernel, AP242 PMI, 1D Tolerance Stack-Up, and GPU photoreal renders — falling back cleanly to Free Basic 3D Viewing & RFQ screening forever.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake screening, DXF preflight, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md.
Native SolidWorks (.SLDPRT/.SLDASM) and Siemens NX (.prt) viewing via NVIDIA usd-convert-cad 0.3.0 installs locally only after explicit operator I ACCEPT license consent.
